metadata.title: Groupicorn Ohio IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Ohio is divided into Cleveland inner/east, Akron/Canton, Columbus, Cincinnati, Dayton, Toledo, Youngstown, Mansfield/Marion, and Athens/Southeastern Ohio catchments. Shortlists use distinct provider groups and preserve local/neighbor labels.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a locally stored PNG acquired from an official provider-controlled source. License clearance is not implied.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.

areas.name: Cleveland Inner / West
areas.definition: Cleveland city and inner western/eastern neighborhoods where health-system behavioral programs are concentrated.
areas.scope_note: Includes central Cleveland and nearby inner suburbs; Beachwood is kept as a separate east-side catchment.
areas.adjacency_basis: Direct urban and freeway-connected Northeast Ohio markets.

areas.name: Cleveland East / Beachwood
areas.definition: East-side Cleveland catchment centered on Beachwood and the I-271 corridor.
areas.scope_note: Thin local provider set; nearby Cleveland and Akron/Canton programs are explicit neighbors.
areas.adjacency_basis: Adjacent east-side suburbs and I-271 corridor.

areas.name: Akron / Canton
areas.definition: Summit and Stark county corridor, including Akron and Canton pediatric and adult programs.
areas.scope_note: Cleveland Clinic Bath is included because it serves the Akron market.
areas.adjacency_basis: Direct I-77 and Route 8 corridor relationships.

areas.name: Columbus Metro
areas.definition: Franklin County and the immediate Columbus suburban treatment market.
areas.scope_note: Includes downtown, north, and west Columbus locations; distinct operators are prioritized over branches.
areas.adjacency_basis: Central Ohio regional hub with direct I-70/I-71 connections.

areas.name: Cincinnati Metro
areas.definition: Greater Cincinnati catchment, including Mason, Norwood, Eastgate, Green Township, and College Hill.
areas.scope_note: Pediatric PHP and adult mental-health/addiction IOP/PHP are represented separately by operator and focus.
areas.adjacency_basis: Greater Cincinnati urban area and I-75 corridor.

areas.name: Dayton / Miami Valley
areas.definition: Dayton and the Miami Valley, including Kettering Health behavioral programs in Moraine and Centerville.
areas.scope_note: Three distinct local groups are publication-ready after the September 22, 2026 pass; independent-provider discovery remains open.
areas.adjacency_basis: I-75 corridor and direct Dayton-Cincinnati/Columbus travel patterns.

areas.name: Toledo Metro
areas.definition: Lucas County and the Toledo treatment market.
areas.scope_note: Three distinct local groups are publication-ready after the September 22, 2026 pass; broader mental-health discovery remains open.
areas.adjacency_basis: Northwest Ohio regional hub with I-80/I-90 connections.

areas.name: Youngstown / Mahoning Valley
areas.definition: Mahoning Valley catchment centered on Youngstown and Boardman.
areas.scope_note: Akron Children's Boardman is a verified pediatric PHP/IOP anchor; adult-provider research remains open.

areas.name: Mansfield / Marion
areas.definition: North-central Ohio regional-hub catchment between Columbus, Akron/Canton, and Toledo.
areas.scope_note: Four distinct local groups are publication-ready after the September 22, 2026 pass; coverage is not treated as statewide representation.
areas.adjacency_basis: US-30, I-71, and US-23 regional connections.

areas.name: Athens / Southeastern Ohio
areas.definition: Southeastern Ohio regional catchment including Athens and adjacent Appalachian communities.
areas.scope_note: No qualifying physical IOP/PHP location was verified in this pass; nearest candidates are shown only as neighbors when useful.
areas.adjacency_basis: Regional-hub catchment with long travel distances to Columbus and Dayton.

research_queue.task: Research Ohio University, Appalachian behavioral-health systems, and regional hubs for current qualifying physical IOP/PHP locations.

research_queue.task: Confirm current PHP availability at the Marion address; current official sources clearly document behavioral outpatient services and IOP evidence, while PHP is less specific.

research_queue.name: All Ohio provider marks
research_queue.task: Review logo license/brand-use status before any public-facing launch; local PNGs are internal research assets.

research_queue.name: Glenbeigh Outpatient Center of Beachwood
research_queue.task: Glenbeigh's current official Beachwood page verifies an in-person IOP at 3789B South Green Road, but a clean official local PNG logo was not resolved during this pass. Acquire and validate the provider mark before publication.

research_queue.name: H.O.P.E. Counseling and Addiction Services
research_queue.task: CARF's current provider record identifies 1319 Florencedale Avenue, Youngstown and adult integrated PHP/IOP, but a current official provider page and official local logo were not resolved. Verify operating status, exact site, and branding before publication.

research_queue.name: Mercy Health Behavioral Health Institute - Youngstown
research_queue.task: A current Mahoning Valley resource booklet identifies an adult dual IOP at Mercy Health St. Elizabeth Hospital, 1044 Belmont Avenue, but a current official Mercy program page and exact local logo were not resolved. Recheck before publication.

research_queue.name: Athens Treatment Services
research_queue.task: Current public records identify Pinnacle/Athens Treatment Services at 8978 United Lane, Suite 102, Athens. Operator pages support outpatient care and third-party current program pages describe IOP, but the current exact local IOP level should be reverified before publication; do not infer PHP from general outpatient language.

research_queue.task: Official provider location page describes Toledo PHP and IOP; verify complete street address and current operating status.
